An aerial film with no integral color masking (the sheet's words). It prints three
characteristic curves for three development times; these are "Developed for Low
Contrast": Process C-41 with its standard 3:15 development (or AN-6, 137 s, 38.9 °C),
daylight exposure, Status M densitometry. The sheet gives this development a gamma of
0.63 and an aerial film speed (EAFS) of 80.
The sheet gives no Log H ref: aerial film speeds aren't pictorial ones. -0.84 is assumed,
where Kodak's ISO 100 still films put a grey card (Gold 100, Ektar 100): log10(0.8 / 100)
+ 1.26. Rebranded as a pictorial film, it is sold rated ISO 100.
